spec.title: Live Hazard Horizon, Magnitude, Weather Context & Severity Table

spec.rawSql:
WITH champ AS (
    SELECT model_version
    FROM eonet_model_registry
    WHERE deployment_role = 'champion'
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.event_id)
    p.event_id AS "Event ID",
    e.title AS "Hazard Title",
    p.category_id AS "Category",
    e.event_time_utc AS "Opened (UTC)",
    p.pred_severity_tier AS "Severity",
    COALESCE(ROUND(e.magnitude_value::numeric, 1)::text || ' ' || COALESCE(e.magnitude_unit, ''), 'N/A') AS "Magnitude",
    ROUND(GREATEST(0, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - e.event_time_utc)) / 86400.0)::numeric, 1) AS "Active Days",
    ROUND((p.pred_remaining_hours / 24.0)::numeric, 1) AS "Remaining (d)",
    ROUND(e.temp_2m_c::numeric, 1) AS "Temp (°C)",
    ROUND(e.humidity_2m_pct::numeric, 0) AS "Humidity (%)",
    ROUND(e.wind_10m_ms::numeric, 1) AS "Wind (m/s)"
FROM eonet_predictions p
JOIN eonet_events_stream e ON p.event_id = e.event_id
WHERE p.status = 'open'
  AND p.model_version = (SELECT model_version FROM champ)
  AND p.category_id IN ($category)
  AND ('${event_search}' = '' OR p.event_id ILIKE '%${event_search}%' OR e.title ILIKE '%${event_search}%')
ORDER BY p.event_id, p.predicted_at_utc DESC;
